name: Joint Doctoral Program in Ecology
institution: San Diego State University / University of California, Davis
summary: Joint PhD awarded by SDSU and UC Davis. You need an SDSU Ecology faculty member who agrees to take you into their lab. Apply to UC Davis first; selected applicants then complete a short second application through Cal State Apply.

deadlines.label: UC Davis application deadline
deadlines.note: UC Davis Graduate Studies lists December 1 as the general deadline for this joint program under its 2027-28 application, and says applications close at 11:59 p.m. Pacific on the deadline day. The program page says 'on or before December 1' (no year) and moves it to the previous working day if the 1st falls on a weekend or holiday. The program's own UC Davis page still shows older dates (December 1, 2024).

timeline.decisions: Review of applications for each fall semester starts in early January.

english.toefl: 80 (exams before 21 Jan 2026); 4.5 out of 6.0 (exams on or after 21 Jan 2026)
english.note: UC Davis minimums, and the program may require higher. IELTS needs 7.0 on a 9-point scale. Duolingo is for applicants who cannot take another test; UC Davis pages differ (115 on one earlier check, 130 on the latest), so the higher is shown. TOEFL and IELTS scores expire after two years. Waived with a degree from a qualifying institution where English is the only language of instruction.

applicationFee.note: UC Davis charges $155 for international applicants and $135 for US applicants. UC Davis offers fee waivers only to applicants who took part in listed graduate preparation programs, not for financial need or other reasons; no citizenship limit is stated, so international applicants should confirm. The program page does not mention a fee for the second (Cal State Apply) application.

documents: UC Davis online application with transcripts (unofficial PDFs accepted; official ones only if admitted)
Personal statement and statement of purpose (UC Davis application)
Curriculum vitae and a statement of research interests, which most faculty ask to see before agreeing to sponsor you
Abbreviated second application through Cal State Apply, for selected applicants
requirements.note: GRE: UC Davis lists 'GRE not required or accepted' for this program. The number of recommendation letters is not stated on the program page; UC Davis says to check the program's requirements. You must meet eligibility requirements at both UC Davis and SDSU, and to be given full consideration should have a GPA above 3.2.

funding.note: Admitted students are offered support from graduate research or teaching assistantships plus a benefits package, typically for 5 years with satisfactory progress. The page gives current stipends of $31,200 to $32,700 depending on progress, without naming a year. It does not say whether this covers international students.

international.note: UC Davis says international applicants complete the same requirements as US applicants and must submit official TOEFL or IELTS unless exempt.

detailsNote: The December 1 deadline comes from UC Davis Graduate Studies' 2027-28 deadline table (read on 22 Oct 2026; the page could not be reopened on 31 Oct). The SDSU program page gives December 1 with no year. Fee and English scores are UC Davis's central rules; the program page itself does not state them. Check them on the official pages.
